one: ML systems design: from data management to deployment and monitoring, plus privacy, fairness, and security.
pos: CS 329S is a project-based ML systems course about the engineering beyond the model: managing data, choosing models, scaling training, monitoring production, and coordinating teams. It also covers privacy, fairness, and security — the real-world issues every system faces.
topics: **Data engineering**: data management, labeling, versioning, quality
**Training and scaling**: distributed systems, cost, experiment management
**People and society**: privacy, fairness, security, teamwork
**Project**: design and implement an ML system
prereq: At least one of CS 229/230/231N/224N; familiarity with one framework (PyTorch/TF/JAX).
assess: Mainly a project plus assignments/reading. Check the current syllabus for details.
who: ML engineers moving from model tuning to systems; researchers who want engineering skills; technical product managers.
tips: Pair with 'Designing Machine Learning Systems'. The project should include monitoring and rollback, not just a model.
note: Not offered in the 2026–27 ExploreCourses listing; the link points to the course materials site.
